I5.quote: In this work, the Helmholtz free energy for fluid – fluid interactions is coupled with the Helmholtz free energy for solid – fluid interactions to calculate the adsorption of non-quantum and quantum fluids under confinement, ...

notes: Purely theoretical modelling paper; the only measured H2 uptake values shown are quoted from other work. Supporting passages: "Experimental adsorption data were taken from Wu et al. [72]." (main, p. 6 (journal p. 330), Table 5 footnote, JX101 activated carbon); "Experimental adsorption data were taken from Ming et al. [66] at 77 K and from Rosi et al. [28] at 298.15 K." (main, p. 3 (journal p. 327), Table 3 footnote); "the adsorption of a non-quantum fluid (neon) and two quantum fluids (helium and hydrogen) in selected solids (i.e., MSC5A, IRMOF-1, IRMOF-6 and JX101) have been estimated using a proposed model" (main, p. 6 (journal p. 330), Section 4 Conclusions). The surface areas quoted (e.g. 1500 m2/g for JX101) are also taken from the cited work. Not a review, not retracted (record is_retracted false; no retraction notice in the PDF).
